declare @uprawnieniaVal table( vgrupaid int, vPermissionId int, vr int, va int, vm int, vd int)
insert into @uprawnieniaVal select idGrupy as [@GroupId], id as [@PermissionId], case when StZ_MaskaFormy & 8 <> 0 then 0 else 1 end as [@Read], case when StZ_MaskaFormy & 1 <> 0 OR (Name in ('SalesInvoice','Receipt') AND PcR_ID is null) then 0 else 1 end as [@Add], case when StZ_MaskaFormy & 2 <> 0 then 0 else 1 end as [@Modify], case when StZ_MaskaFormy & 4 <> 0 then 0 else 1 end as [@Delete] from @grupy cross apply (select * from @uprawnienia where Name in ('SalesInvoice', 'SalesInvoiceQuantityCorrection', 'Receipt', 'ReceiptQuantityCorrection', 'ConsentsToPersonalDataProcessing', 'CashBankDeposit', 'CashBankWithDrawal')) a left join cdn.StaZakazy on StZ_StaNumer = idGrupy AND ( (StZ_ProcID=2909 and Name='SalesInvoice') OR (StZ_ProcID=2911 AND Name='SalesInvoiceQuantityCorrection') OR (StZ_ProcID=2916 AND Name='Receipt') OR (StZ_ProcID=2918 AND Name='ReceiptQuantityCorrection') OR (StZ_ProcID=30733 AND Name='ConsentsToPersonalDataProcessing') OR (StZ_ProcID=8302 AND Name in ('CashBankDeposit','CashBankWithDrawal')) ) left join cdn.PicoKonfig on PcK_PicoID = @pckid left join cdn.FrmStruktura on frs_id = PcK_CentrumID left join cdn.DokDefinicje on dok_frsid = frs_id and case when Dok_GIDTyp = 2033 then 'SalesInvoice' when Dok_GIDTyp = 2034 then 'Receipt' else '' end = Name left join cdn.PicoRelacje on PcR_OBITyp=4320 AND PcR_OBINumer = Dok_Id
union all select idGrupy as [@GroupId], id as [@PermissionId], CASE WHEN Name = 'Configuration' THEN Sta_POSKonfiguracja WHEN Name = 'UIConfiguration' THEN Sta_POSKonfInterfejs WHEN Name = 'PrintDailyCashReport' THEN Sta_POSDrukRaportFiskalnyDob WHEN Name = 'PrintPeriodCashReport' THEN Sta_POSDrukRaportOkresowy WHEN Name = 'OtherOperatorsDocumentsEdit' THEN Sta_POSEdycjaDokOpe WHEN Name = 'ShiftStartWithDifferenceInCashRegisterBalance' THEN Sta_POSOtwarcieZmianyZRoznicaSK WHEN Name = 'ShiftEndWithoutWithdrawal' THEN Sta_POSZamkniecieZmianyBezWyplaty WHEN Name = 'ExceedingCashRegisterLimit' THEN Sta_POSPrzekroczenieLimituSK WHEN Name = 'Refiscalization' THEN Sta_POSOznaczDokZafiskalizowane WHEN Name = 'CustomersModification' THEN Sta_POSDodEdycjaKnt WHEN Name = 'ManualOpenDrawer' THEN Sta_POSReczneOtwarcieSzuflady ELSE 0 END as [@Read], 0 as [@Add], 0 as [@Modify], 0 as [@Delete] from @grupy JOIN CDN.StaKarty ON idGrupy = Sta_GIDNumer cross apply (select * from @uprawnienia where Name in ('Configuration', 'UIConfiguration', --'', Ręczne otwarcie szuflady Nowy parametr od wersji 2018.5 'PrintDailyCashReport', 'PrintPeriodCashReport', 'CustomersModification', 'OtherOperatorsDocumentsEdit', 'ShiftStartWithDifferenceInCashRegisterBalance', 'ShiftEndWithoutWithdrawal', 'ExceedingCashRegisterLimit', 'Refiscalization', 'ManualOpenDrawer')) a
SELECT @dbts AS [@RowVersion],( select vgrupaid as [@GroupId], vPermissionId as [@PermissionId], vr as [@Read], va as [@Add], vm as [@Modify], vd as [@Delete] from @uprawnieniaVal ORDER BY vgrupaid,vPermissionId for xml path('GroupPermission'), type) for xml path('GroupPermissions') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
